title: Maximum distance calculation
description: Essential: The final answer for the maximum distance between the cars must be 64 m.

title: Catch-up time calculation
description: Essential: The final answer for the total time for car A to catch up must be 16 s.

title: Minimum acceleration condition
description: Essential: The final answer for the minimum acceleration of car A to avoid collision must be 8/31 m/s².

title: Time of equal speeds
description: Important: The solution must correctly find the time (t1 = 6 s) when the speeds of car A and car B become equal.

title: B's stopping time and displacement
description: Important: The solution must correctly calculate the time (t0 = 10 s) and displacement (100 m) for car B to come to a complete stop.

title: Relative motion analysis
description: Important: The solution must correctly analyze the relative positions and motions after car B has stopped to find the remaining catch-up time (t2 = 6 s).

title: Displacement equations setup
description: Optional: The solution clearly sets up displacement equations for both cars using correct kinematic formulas for constant velocity and constant deceleration.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: All calculations maintain consistent units (meters, seconds, m/s²) throughout.

title: Sign error in deceleration
description: Pitfall: Using acceleration instead of deceleration (wrong sign) for car B's motion in the kinematic equations.

title: Ignoring initial separation
description: Pitfall: Failing to include the initial 28 m separation (x0) when calculating relative displacements or the catch-up condition.
